title: Gui Li against Lin Jingyu
summary: At the Heavenly King's Treasure Vault, Gui Li wants the artefact inside and Lin Jingyu blocks the way, refusing to let it fall to the Demon Sect. Lin Jingyu asks why Gui Li still uses Qingyun techniques; Gui Li says he uses Qingyun's arts and the Demon Sect's alike to kill. Lin Jingyu says he was the one who lost ten years ago and challenges Gui Li's mix of Buddhist, Taoist and demonic arts, and the two old friends fight with Qingyun spells and Gui Li's blood arts. Gui Li notes that Lin Jingyu reached Upper Purity in only ten years, while Lin Jingyu senses Buddhist power inside Gui Li's Qingyun moves. Jin Ping'er arrives, having held back three righteous disciples, and proposes working with Gui Li for now. Fa Xiang and Zeng Shushu catch up; Zeng Shushu calls Gui Li 'Xiaofan', but Gui Li says his name is Gui Li. The ancient Black Water Serpent rises from below to guard the vault, and Lu Xueqi throws herself in Gui Li's way while Qing Long and Zhu Que prepare their formation nearby.
